name: chat
label: Chat
description: Send messages to Hermes using the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API (POST /v1/chat/completions). Stateless — pass the full conversation in the messages array each call.

model.description: Model name (typically the Hermes profile name). The actual LLM used is configured server-side; this field is cosmetic.

messages.description: Full conversation as an array of {role, content} objects. Roles: system, user, assistant. Content can be a string or an array of typed parts for multimodal input.

stream.description: If true, returns Server-Sent Events. n8n will collect all chunks and return the concatenated text plus the raw event list.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0-2). Accepted but actual sampling is configured server-side.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. Accepted but enforced server-side.

sessionId.description: Opt-in session continuity. Sent as the X-Hermes-Session-Id header — Hermes reuses the same agent session across calls with this ID.

sessionKey.description: Opt-in long-term memory scoping. Sent as the X-Hermes-Session-Key header — namespaces persistent memory for this session.
